rawRetro.summary: Repaired the only observed failing check: the repository-wide Prettier format check failed on AGENTS.md because commit e318f4e left two consecutive blank lines before the '## Controlled failed-delivery smoke' heading. Removed the extra blank line; the customer-memo feature itself was already implemented and its targeted tests passed.

improvements.title: Format check can fail on a freshly generated application
improvements.detail: AGENTS.md shipped with a Prettier violation (double blank line before a heading) introduced when the controlled failed-delivery smoke section was added in e318f4e. Because `pnpm format:check` runs Prettier across the whole application, every generated app inherits a failing format check unrelated to its own code.
improvements.suggestedChange: Run `pnpm format:check` (or Prettier on the template's committed Markdown) as part of the template release/publish step, or add the same check to the factory template repository so a committed formatting defect fails before it reaches a generated application.

problems.title: Prettier format check failed on AGENTS.md
problems.symptom: `pnpm format:check` (prettier . --check) exited 1 with `[warn] AGENTS.md`. All application feature files were reported unchanged/formatted.
problems.rootCause: AGENTS.md contained two consecutive blank lines between the end of the 'Factory task termination' section and the '## Controlled failed-delivery smoke' heading. Prettier normalizes that to a single blank line, so the committed file failed its own format check.
problems.resolution: Removed the extra blank line in AGENTS.md. Verified `npx prettier AGENTS.md --check` passes, targeted Prettier on all feature files passes, targeted ESLint on all changed/added TypeScript files exits 0, and the relevant tests (tests/logic/customer-memos.test.ts, tests/logic/client-routes.test.ts, tests/components/customer-memo-form.test.tsx) pass 13/13.

evaluation.summary: 以内部“客户备忘录”小系统为场景，评测 NocoBase3 与业务直接相关的 7 个内部包及随附 Skill：@nocobase/db、@nocobase/repository-input、@nocobase/app-server、@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication、@nocobase/app-client、@nocobase/i18n、@nocobase/app-plugin-i18n。五个能力单元（迁移/种子、Repository 读写与过滤、服务端路由与鉴权、客户端路由与 API、国际化）都由框架公共 API 直接支撑，指引准确、Agent 基本一次成型，五维评分集中在 85–92。Repository 的 filter.string().includes({mode:'insensitive'}) 编译为 lower(..) like lower(..)，使“部分名称、大小写不敏感”搜索成为一等能力。发现两处非内核问题：示例/演示数据没有正式承载路径（文档缺口），以及模板 AGENTS.md 触发工厂第 2 轮格式化修复。原始 3 条调用日志已全部引用，6 个显式错误信号已逐一处置，未见框架实现缺陷。

# Migrations and seeds

This page is the application side: where the directories live, how `pnpm nocobase db apply` runs them, how additional connections configure their tasks, and what to do about checksum drift and compiled manifests.

How to write the files themselves — the migration and seed shape, the immutability and self-containment rules, the Collection Builder, and which of `builder`, `query` and `repository` a task context should reach for — belongs to the package that owns them. Read `.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md` sections 2 and 3 before writing one, and run `pnpm nocobase skills sync` if that file is missing.

Migrations under `database/main/migrations/` are the application's schema history. Seeds under `database/main/seeds/` insert records the application requires to run. Migrations create structure. Seeds never do.

`database/tsconfig.json` extends the server configuration so editor tooling and ESLint recognize migrations and seeds as Node source. Keep it in place when adding connection directories.

## Running

```bash
pnpm nocobase db apply
```

This applies pending migrations and then pending seeds for `database.default`, including registered plugins, ordered by name across all sources. Both halves run only what is pending, so on an already-migrated database it applies seeds alone. The template defaults to `main`. Plugin migrations, seeds and runtime default reads/writes always use this same connection; changing `database.default` changes the application system database.

Seeds are the second half of that run, so the structure a seed writes into must already exist from an earlier migration. Keep seed data fixed and reproducible — no current timestamps or random values in identifying fields — and never let a repeat run silently overwrite data a user has edited.

## Multiple connections

Use `database/<connectionName>/migrations` and `database/<connectionName>/seeds`. Each name must match a configured connection and contain only letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. Directories do not register connections. A connection without application-owned database source needs no empty directory.

Configure `connections.<name>.migrations` and `.seeds` in the database section. Each accepts `autoRun`, `directory` or `sources`, `packageName`, `tableName`, `lockTableName`, and `extensions`. Explicit paths resolve relative to the application root and must exist when executed. Without an explicit path the application resolves the per-connection directory under its runtime database directory, including `dist/database` after compilation. Custom sources replace the application's conventional source; registered plugin sources are still added only on the default connection.

The default connection runs migrations and seeds automatically unless disabled; other connections default to `autoRun: false`. Startup runs the default connection first, then other names in stable ascending order, migrations before seeds within each connection. A failure stops startup; completed database changes remain committed. No cross-connection transaction or rollback is provided.

- **Keep `componentLoader` lazy**. Route information is declared synchronously, so the router can resolve navigation without downloading every page; page code is downloaded only when the page is visited.

# Copy and translation

All text a user can see goes through a translation key: titles, buttons, column headers, placeholders, `aria-label`, toasts and validation messages all count. Text hard-coded in a component cannot be translated, and changing its wording means changing code.

For the wording itself (which verb a button uses, how to write empty states and errors, how to put record names in quotes), see section C of `../ui-guidelines.md`; this document covers only how to write the code.

## Where copy lives

| File                      | Purpose                                                                                     |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `client/locales/en-US.ts` | English; also defines the structure of the copy and exports the type `AppResource`          |
| `client/locales/zh-CN.ts` | Chinese; typed as `AppResource`, so its structure must match the English                    |
| `client/locales/index.ts` | One dynamic `import()` per language, so the browser downloads only the language being shown |

Rules:

- Each new feature gets its own group (`projects: { … }`), which holds all of the feature's copy.
- Add menu titles to the existing `navigation` group (`navigation.projects`), and write `navigation: { title: 'navigation.projects' }` in the route (see `page.md`).
- Add the key to `en-US.ts` first, then add the same key to `zh-CN.ts`. A key missing from `zh-CN.ts` or extra in it (including a misspelled one) fails type checking.
- **Keys passed to `t()` are not type-checked.** `t('projects.titel')` compiles, and the page shows `projects.titel` as is. So always look at the page in both languages (see "Checks").
- When you copy structure from the reference pages (`client/pages/reference/`), move the copy into the feature's own group in `client/locales/`. The reference pages' copy is in `client/pages/reference/locales/`; it is not part of the build, so do not reference it.

## Existing shared keys

| Key                                                                  | English                      | Chinese                |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | ---------------------- |
| `actions.save`, `actions.cancel`, `actions.close`, `actions.confirm` | Save, Cancel, Close, Confirm | 保存、取消、关闭、确认 |
| `status.loading`, `status.retry`                                     | Loading, Retry               | 加载中、重试           |

In the file, `status.*` are flat dotted keys (`'status.loading': 'Loading'`); you call them the same way as nested keys.

The groups `actions`, `status`, `navigation`, `dataTable` and `datePicker` are used by the application shell and shared components. A key added to `actions` must meet both conditions:

1. It is a generic action or action state with no object, and it means the same on any page, for example "Saving…" (`actions.saving`).
2. Its translation does not vary by feature. If the same English word needs a different translation in some feature, put it in that feature's group.

# Procedure

## Adding a string

1. Find the package that owns the text. Application text goes in `client/locales/`; a plugin's text goes in that plugin's `client/locales/`.
2. Add the key to `en-US.ts`. The structure is written once: the type is derived from the value with `LocaleResource<typeof enUS>`, and other locales are annotated with it, which is what makes a typo a compile error.
3. Add the translation to every other locale file. A missing key falls back rather than breaking, so this can lag, and `typecheck` reports it.
4. Render it with `useTranslation` from `@nocobase/i18n/client`.

```tsx
import { useTranslation } from '@nocobase/i18n/client';

const { t } = useTranslation();
t('actions.save');
```

Keys nest and are addressed with dots: `t('trigger.types.schedule')`.

## Naming translation keys

Use short semantic keys that describe the purpose of the text and stay valid when its wording changes. Use lower camelCase within each segment and dots for useful feature or context groups, such as `files.uploadFailed` or `demo.pageDescription`. A small namespace may use `title` directly. Do not use complete English sentences as keys or merely convert a sentence into camelCase.
